questions.question: What can the L1 penalty do to some coefficients?
questions.question_ar: ماذا يمكن لعقوبة L1 أن تفعل ببعض المعاملات؟
options: how much features contribute to reducing impurity
only after removing every feature with variance
before model training using statistical measures
force some coefficients to become exactly zero
options_en: how much features contribute to reducing impurity
only after removing every feature with variance
before model training using statistical measures
force some coefficients to become exactly zero
options_ar: مقدار مساهمة الخصائص في تقليل عدم النقاء
بعد إزالة كل خاصية ذات تباين فقط
قبل تدريب النموذج باستخدام مقاييس إحصائية
جعل بعض المعاملات تساوي صفراً تماماً

questions.question: When do Decision Trees select features?
questions.explanation: Decision trees select features when constructing the tree.

questions.question: What can Random Forest feature importance measure?
questions.question_ar: ماذا يمكن أن يقيس تقدير أهمية الخصائص في الغابة العشوائية؟
options: how many branches exist in a search tree
only after a dataset is converted into an FP-tree
how much features contribute to reducing impurity
how frequently items occur together in transactions
options_en: how many branches exist in a search tree
only after a dataset is converted into an FP-tree
how much features contribute to reducing impurity
how frequently items occur together in transactions
options_ar: عدد الفروع الموجودة في شجرة البحث
بعد تحويل مجموعة البيانات إلى شجرة FP فقط
مقدار مساهمة الخصائص في تقليل عدم النقاء
مدى تكرار ظهور العناصر معاً في المعاملات
questions.explanation: Random Forest can calculate feature importance based on how much features contribute to reducing impurity or, depending on the method, how much they affect prediction performance.
questions.explanation_ar: مقدار مساهمة الخصائص في تقليل عدم النقاء

questions.question: What may be done with features of very low importance?
questions.question_ar: ماذا يمكن فعله بالخصائص ذات الأهمية المنخفضة جداً؟
options: only after recursively mining a projected database
only after a dataset is converted into an FP-tree
Features with very low importance may be removed.
Features with very low importance become the target variable.
options_en: only after recursively mining a projected database
only after a dataset is converted into an FP-tree
Features with very low importance may be removed.
Features with very low importance become the target variable.
options_ar: بعد التنقيب التكراري في قاعدة بيانات مسقطة فقط
بعد تحويل مجموعة البيانات إلى شجرة FP فقط
يمكن إزالة الخصائص ذات الأهمية المنخفضة جداً.
تصبح الخصائص ذات الأهمية المنخفضة جداً متغير الهدف.
questions.explanation: Features with very low importance may be removed.
questions.explanation_ar: يمكن إزالة الخصائص ذات الأهمية المنخفضة جداً.

questions.question: When do Filter Methods select features relative to model training?
questions.question_ar: متى تختار طرائق الترشيح الخصائص مقارنة بتدريب النموذج؟
questions.explanation: Filter methods select features before model training. Wrapper methods select features by repeatedly evaluating a model. Embedded methods select features as part of model training.

questions.question: When do Embedded Methods select features?
questions.explanation: Filter methods select features before model training. Wrapper methods select features by repeatedly evaluating a model. Embedded methods select features as part of model training.
